turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi! Please send your order number and the email address you used at checkout so I can check where your print is and look up the tracking link.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.
I can’t look up an order by name alone. To check its status or share a tracking link, I need the order number and the email address used at checkout.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.
I can’t share the delivery address or confirm whether your print has shipped without verifying the order number and the email address used at checkout.
